review.note: Release 0.3.3 corrects POSIX nested process ownership: a canonical owner registers its cleanup obligation before starting a new session; outer cleanup closes admission and cannot force-kill the inner owner or claim an empty tree until nested groups are proven empty. Unexpected inner-owner death, unavailable ledger evidence, or an unproven cleanup remain fail-closed. Existing public CLI arguments, snapshot schema and dependency constraints are unchanged. The added private process-scope module is included in the authoritative process component and reviewer dependency closure. Quality-first design uses one shared ownership protocol rather than longer grace periods or a parallel watchdog. Real nested-owner, interrupted Git-hook, standalone-reviewer and exported-snapshot regressions validate the implementation; native Windows Job behavior remains a separate CI responsibility and is not claimed as locally executed. A fresh live registry discovery found exactly the direct dependency candidates already reviewed for 0.3.2: hatchling 1.32.4, packaging 26.3, build 1.6.1, mypy 2.4.0, pytest 9.1.1, pytest-xdist 3.8.0, Ruff 0.17.0 and markdownlint-cli2 0.23.3. Installed Python versions match these candidates. Previously reviewed primary release notes remain applicable: https://hatch.pypa.io/dev/history/hatchling/ https://packaging.pypa.io/en/stable/changelog.html https://build.pypa.io/en/stable/changelog.html https://mypy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/changelog.html https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/changelog.html https://pytest-xdist.readthedocs.io/en/latest/changelog.html https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/releases/tag/0.17.0 https://github.com/DavidAnson/markdownlint-cli2/blob/v0.23.3/CHANGELOG.md . No new pin, relaxed bound, fallback ownership claim or compatibility exception is introduced. Fresh artifact resolution, online review and the canonical full gate remain distinct required evidence.
